bio: The fine dining restaurant of the Dolomitengolf Suites hotel has a modern and elegant feel. Through the large windows facing the terrace, feast your eyes on views of the golf course and mountains. The menu sees regional ingredients combined with international influences, as in, for example, "beef tartare, chive mayonnaise, radishes, focaccia" or "truffle tagliatelle, baby spinach, pickled egg yolk". Friendly and knowledgeable service.
